sentences.en: I was impressed by the general knowledge of Japanese students.
sentences.zh: 日本学生的知识面给我留下了深刻的印象。

sentences.en: His courage impressed me enough for me to trust him.
sentences.zh: 他的勇气让我印象深刻，足以信任他。

sentences.en: I can't believe you weren't as impressed as I was.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信你没有像我一样被深深打动。

senses.zh: 盖印；强征；传送；给予某人深刻印象

collocations.zh: 因为某事使某人印象深刻
